Name: Dark Brown Transparent Interface
Author: HopeWasHere
Description:
Based on the transparent dialog box replica by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/transparent-dialogue-box.148805/]coldazrael[/url], this is a transparent user interface to match.
Not all instances of the UI have been tested, but I feel like I've done enough for now

Known Bugs -
I forgot about the language selection. I might change later, or I might leave it. I don't know
If there are any others you find, feel free to let me know, or don't

Big thanks to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/coldazrael.983574/]coldazrael[/url] for their replica mod, that can be found here: https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/transparent-dialogue-box.148805/
And a big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50634006]megmom84[/url] for their permission to edit their content patcher mod to be able to figure out how to make this mod. It's a really great UI replacement mod, so if you find you don't like this one I highly recommend checking that one out here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2417
